2607.26765.title: Searching for Robust Augmentations to Improve Out-of-Domain Generalization in Dermoscopic Skin Cancer Classification
2607.26765.paper_summary: Background/Objectives: Dermoscopic skin lesion classifiers often lose accuracy under domain shift across imaging devices, illumination, and capture artifacts. We study how data augmentation improves the robustness of a binary malignant-versus-non-malignant classifier, with emphasis on out-of-domain (OOD) generalization. Methods: Single augmentations, photometric combinations, and composite policies were searched on a multi-source ISIC Archive collection with Derm7pt, using a ConvNeXt-Large backbone and ROC-AUC. Splits were made at the lesion-ID level, and HAM10000 and ISIC 2019-2020 were held out as a predominantly source-disjoint OOD test. Results: The largest OOD gain came from the mix policy, and photometric transformations dominated the most useful OOD operations. On an expanded pool from the same held-out sources the gain was +0.053 (95% CI +0.045 to +0.061, p<0.001), consistent across four training seeds (per-seed ROC-AUC: baseline 0.761-0.775, mix 0.806-0.829). On a small independent clinical collection, single-checkpoint sensitivity rose from 0.591 to 0.818, but this rested on 22 malignant cases and did not persist across seeds. Conclusions: Augmentations modelling real sources of domain shift can matter more than maximizing in-domain accuracy. Because the policy was selected on the same sources used to evaluate it, a source-disjoint selection protocol is needed before this effect size can be read as unbiased.
2607.26765.paper_summary_zh: 背景/目的：皮膚病變的皮膚鏡分類器在不同影像設備、照明和捕捉工件之間的領域轉移下，通常會失去準確性。我們研究數據增強如何改善二元惡性與非惡性分類器的穩健性，重點在於域外（OOD）泛化。方法：在使用 ConvNeXt-Large 主幹和 ROC-AUC 的多源 ISIC 存檔集合上，對單一增強、光度組合和複合策略進行了搜尋。按病變 ID 層級進行了劃分，HAM10000 和 ISIC 2019-2020 被保留作為主要來源不重疊的 OOD 測試。結果：最大的 OOD 增益來自混合策略，光度變換主導了最有用的 OOD 操作。在來自相同保留來源的擴展池中，增益為 +0.053（95% CI +0.045 至 +0.061，p<0.001），在四個訓練種子中一致（每種子 ROC-AUC：基線 0.761-0.775，混合 0.806-0.829）。在一個小型獨立臨床集合中，單一檢查點的敏感性從 0.591 上升到 0.818，但這基於 22 例惡性病例，並未在不同種子間持續。結論：模擬真實領域轉移來源的增強可能比最大化域內準確性更重要。因為該策略是在用於評估的相同來源上選擇的，因此在這種效果大小被視為無偏之前，需要一個來源不重疊的選擇協議。
